comparison.objective: Candidate separates ceramic finishing media from retained washers; pr-1814 removes a latched hot air-fryer basket and places it on a mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual screen handling, pouring, and controlled agitation of many free bodies; pr-1814 tests release actuation or directional unhooking, handle lifting, and hot-surface avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no spill/contamination/damage, and a released 3 s dwell; pr-1814 requires the basket released, stable on the mat, with no hot contact, bypass, or drop.
comparison.reason: All nine specifications were available; revisions change the basket release mechanism and safety rubric but none tests aperture-based granular separation, and no comparison-critical rubric detail is missing.
